mapper.select: SELECT ud.user_deposit_id, ud.user_id, ud.bank_name, ud.product_name, ud.join_date, ud.maturity_date, ud.applied_rate, ud.base_rate, ud.principal_amount FROM user_deposits ud WHERE ud.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ud.maturity_date ASC, ud.user_deposit_id DESC

SELECT c.loan_product_id FROM credit_loan_qualification_condition c WHERE
c.credit_loan_qualification_condition_question_id IN
#{questionId}
1 = 0
GROUP BY c.loan_product_id
HAVING COUNT( DISTINCT c.credit_loan_qualification_condition_question_id ) = ( SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT c2.credit_loan_qualification_condition_question_id ) FROM credit_loan_qualification_condition c2 WHERE c2.loan_product_id = c.loan_product_id )

SELECT LEAST( COALESCE(SUM(r.discount_rate), 0), p.max_discount_rate ) AS final_discount_rate
FROM credit_loan_products p
LEFT JOIN credit_loan_preferential_rate r ON p.loan_product_id = r.loan_product_id
AND r.credit_loan_preferential_condition_question_id IN
#{questionId}
AND 1 = 0
WHERE p.loan_product_id = #{loanProductId}
GROUP BY p.loan_product_id, p.max_discount_rate
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comparisons ( user_id, user_deposit_id, urgent_amount, monthly_payment, is_partial_allowed, is_lump_sum, loan_name, loan_type, loan_interest_rate, rate_period_months, loan_interest, loan_penalty, deposit_name, deposit_maintain_interest, deposit_cancel_interest_rate, deposit_cancel_interest, a_final_balance, b_final_balance, winner, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{userDepositId}, #{urgentAmount}, #{monthlyPayment}, #{isPartialAllowed}, #{isLumpSum}, #{loanName}, #{loanType}, #{loanInterestRate}, #{ratePeriodMonths}, #{loanInterest}, #{loanPenalty}, #{depositName}, #{depositMaintainInterest}, #{depositCancelInterestRate}, #{depositCancelInterest}, #{aFinalBalance}, #{bFinalBalance}, #{winner}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT user_deposit_id, user_id, bank_name, product_name, join_date, maturity_date, applied_rate, base_rate, principal_amount FROM user_deposits WHERE user_deposit_id = #{userDepositId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 'N'

SELECT g.loan_product_id, p.product_name, g.rate_period_months, g.base_rate, g.spread_rate, p.loan_limit FROM credit_loan_grade_rate g JOIN credit_loan_products p ON p.loan_product_id = g.loan_product_id WHERE g.credit_grade = #{creditGrade} AND g.loan_product_id IN
#{productId}
SELECT * FROM comparisons WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
